title: "Clean_and_Filter_data"
format: html

## Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Read and load data

```{r}
FF_genome_raw <- read.table('../../../Big_data/FlyingFlies_SNPtable.txt', header = T)

# Note: frequency here refers to Reference allele frequency. If freq is low, then alternate allele frequency is high. 

```

## Set up allele frequency data and factors, filter allele frequency

```{r}
FF_frequency_raw <- FF_genome_raw %>% select(CHROM, POS, contains("freq_")) %>% filter(CHROM %in% c("2L", "2R", "3L", "3R", "4", "X", "Y")) %>% pivot_longer(cols = starts_with('freq_'), names_to = "population", values_to = "alle_freq") %>% mutate(Chromosome = factor(CHROM))

freq_factors <- FF_frequency_raw %>% separate_wider_delim(
  cols = population, 
  delim = "_",
  names = c(NA, "Population", "Generation", "Sample"))

freq_factors <- freq_factors %>% mutate(Population = factor(Population), Sample = factor(Sample)) %>% separate_wider_regex(
  cols = Population, 
  patterns = c("Selection" = ".*", "PopReplicate" = "\\d$")) %>% mutate(Selection = factor(Selection), PopReplicate = factor(PopReplicate))

allele_frequency_data <- freq_factors %>% select(Selection, PopReplicate, Chromosome, POS, alle_freq)

# filter out <2% alt. allele frequency (i.e., ref freq. >98%)

allele_frequency_data <- allele_frequency_data %>% filter(alle_freq < 0.98)
```

## Plot Coverage Depth

```{r}
Coverage <- FF_genome_raw %>% select(contains("N_")) %>% pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Coverage") %>% mutate(Log_Coverage = log10(Coverage))

ggplot(data = Coverage) + geom_boxplot(aes(Sample, Log_Coverage))

Mean_Coverage <- Coverage %>% group_by(Sample) %>% summarise(m_log_cover = mean(Log_Coverage))
```

### Filter Trials

#### Coverage Filter

```{r}
filt_cover <- Coverage %>% filter(Coverage >= 30)

ggplot(data = filt_cover) + geom_boxplot(aes(Sample, Log_Coverage))
```

#### Frequency data processing

```{r}
chr_chrom <- FF_genome_raw$CHROM

fact_chrom <- factor(chr_chrom)
fact_chrom <- fact_chrom[fact_chrom %in% c("2L", "2R", "3L", "3R", "4", "X", "Y")]

filtered_chrom_values = length(chr_chrom) - length(fact_chrom)

allele_freq <- FF_genome_raw %>% select(CHROM, POS, contains("freq_")) %>% filter(CHROM %in% c("2L", "2R", "3L", "3R", "4", "X", "Y")) %>% pivot_longer(cols = starts_with('freq_'), names_to = "population", values_to = "alle_freq") %>% mutate(Chromosome = factor(CHROM))

# ggplot(data = allele_freq) + geom_boxplot(aes(population, alle_freq))
```

#### Practice chunk

```{r}
pop_split <- allele_freq %>% separate_wider_delim(
  cols = population, 
  delim = "_",
  names = c(NA, "Population", "Generation", "Sample"))

pop_split <- pop_split %>% mutate(Population = factor(Population), Sample = factor(Sample)) %>% separate_wider_regex(
  cols = Population, 
  patterns = c("Selection" = ".*", "PopReplicate" = "\\d$")) %>% mutate(Selection = factor(Selection), PopReplicate = factor(PopReplicate))
```

#### Allele Frequency Data

```{r}
allele_frequency_data <- pop_split %>% select(Selection, PopReplicate, Chromosome, POS, alle_freq) %>% filter(alle_freq < 0.98)

ggplot(data = allele_frequency_data, aes(x = Selection, y = alle_freq, color = PopReplicate)) + geom_boxplot()
```
